intros.cottars-1920-camp: Cottar's 1920s Safari Camp sits on a 7,608 acre private conservancy beside the Masai Mara, with canvas tents in the style of the 1920s, family suites, a honeymoon tent and an exclusive bush villa. There is a pool and spa, with game drives, walks, balloon flights and Maasai visits. Fly to Cottar's airstrip.
intros.asilia-dunia-camp: Dunia is eight safari tents in the central Serengeti, run by an all female team, each with a private deck and wide views. Days bring game drives in the path of the migration and tracking big cats and black rhino in the Moru Kopjes. Fly to the Seronera airstrip.
intros.encounter-mara-camp-by-asilia: Encounter Mara is ten safari tents in the Mara Naboisho Conservancy, each with indoor and outdoor showers and a private deck over the savanna. It is known for big cats, with off road and night drives and walking safaris. Fly to the Ol Seki airstrip.
intros.governors-camp: Governors' Camp has been on its site on the Mara River since 1972, with nineteen tents overlooking the river and five family tents facing the open plains. It welcomes children of any age, and the Marsh Pride and the migration are on the doorstep. Fly to the Musiara airstrip.
intros.governors-il-moran-camp: Il Moran is ten tents under riverine forest on the banks of the Mara River inside the reserve, each with a private veranda and a bathroom with a standalone bath. It is a quiet camp for honeymooners, couples and families with children aged eight and over. Fly to the Musiara airstrip.
intros.greystoke-mahale-by-nomad: Greystoke Mahale is eight bandas built from reclaimed dhow wood on a beach of Lake Tanganyika, with the Mahale Mountains rising behind. The chimpanzees of the forest are the reason to come, with time on the lake in between. Fly in by charter from Arusha or Kigoma.
intros.hemingways-nairobi: Hemingways Nairobi is a 45 suite hotel on ten acres in Karen, each suite with a balcony facing the Ngong Hills, holding a MICHELIN Key. It has a heated pool, a spa and a wine cellar, and Wilson Airport is about twenty minutes away for flights to the Mara and Laikipia. Nairobi National Park and the Giraffe Centre are close.
intros.house-in-the-wild: House in the Wild is an owner run lodge of ten rooms in cottages on the Mara River, in a rewilded conservancy, from the two bedroom Original Cottage to River Cottage for couples. It suits families, couples and returning safari goers who want a private conservancy away from the crowds.
intros.house-in-the-wild-masai-mara: House in the Wild sits on the Mara River in a private conservancy, with a main house, River and Family Cottages and the option to take the whole place. Days bring game drives, bush walks, village visits, river fishing and food from its own farm. Fly to the Mara North or Ngerende airstrip.
intros.kicheche-mara-north: Kicheche Mara North is nine tents in the Mara North Conservancy, each with a private veranda over the savannah, with family and triple tents and the option of the whole camp. It is solar powered and plastic free, with game drives, walks and bush breakfasts. Fly to the Mara North airstrip.
intros.kokoko-camp-by-asilia: Kokoko is three tents on the dry Mwagusi riverbed in Ruaha, each with an outdoor bucket shower, a private veranda and a roof that opens for the stars. Days bring game drives, walks, night drives and dinners in the riverbed, for guests aged twelve and over. Fly to the Msembe airstrip.
intros.manyara-tree-lodge-by-and-beyond: Lake Manyara Tree Lodge is a set of treehouse suites in the forest of Lake Manyara National Park, with a family suite for children. Days bring game drives under the Rift Valley escarpment, walks on the lake plains and dinners in the bush. Fly to the Lake Manyara airstrip.
intros.lengishu-kenya: Lengishu is a private house on Borana in the Kenyan highlands, with six bedrooms in four cottages, its own staff and chef, and an infinity pool looking over the Borana hills to Mount Kenya. Take the whole house or a cottage, with private vehicles and guides. Fly to Lewa Downs.
intros.lewa-wilderness-lodge: Lewa Wilderness is nine thatched cottages on Lewa looking over the valley or the gardens, with family cottages and hillside cottages with fireplaces. Days bring game drives by day and night, walks, horse and camel safaris and flights in a vintage biplane. Fly to Lewa Downs or Nanyuki.
intros.loldia-house: Loldia House is a 1943 farmhouse on a private 6,500 acre conservancy on the shore of Lake Naivasha, with rooms in the main house and in garden cottages. It welcomes children of any age and pairs well with the Masai Mara, with boats on the lake and flamingos on the shore. Fly to the Loldia Ranch airstrip.
intros.loirien-mara: Lorien Mara is six canvas suites in a private conservancy beside the Masai Mara, each with a private deck and indoor and outdoor showers, around a lounge and fire pit with Mara views. Days bring game drives, walks and Maasai village visits. Fly to Ol Kiombo or Mara North.
intros.beyond-mnemba-by-and-beyond: Mnemba Island is a private island off Zanzibar with twelve beach bandas, including a family banda, each with a beach lounge, day bed and outdoor shower. Snorkelling starts from the shore, with diving, kayaking, dhow cruises and green turtles nesting. Fly into Zanzibar for the boat to the island.
intros.mwiba-lodge: Mwiba Lodge is ten tented suites on the boulders of an outcrop above a river gorge in a private Southern Serengeti wildlife area, each with a deep soaking tub and a private deck. It suits couples, friends and families with children aged four and over. Fly to the Mwiba airstrip.
intros.asilia-naboisho-camp-by-asilia: Naboisho Camp is nine tents in the Mara Naboisho Conservancy, each with indoor and outdoor showers and a deck facing the savanna, with a pool and a campfire. It is known for big cats, with off road and night drives, walks and balloon flights. Fly to the Ol Seki airstrip.
intros.namiri-plains-camp-by-asilia: Namiri Plains is eleven tented suites in the eastern Serengeti, each with an outdoor bath and a viewing deck, around a main area with a pool, library and spa. It is known for cheetah and lion, with walks and full days on the southern plains. Fly to the Seronera airstrip.
intros.ngare-camp-by-serian: Ngare Camp is four tents on the bank of the Mara River, each with a bath on its veranda facing the water, with an optional raised treehouse, The Nest. It has its own vehicle and guide and access to a private 1,500 acre conservancy, with no Wi-Fi. Fly to the Mara North airstrip.
intros.nimali-mara: Nimali Mara is eight tented suites and two honeymoon suites in the kopjes of the northern Serengeti above the Mara River crossings, each with a private deck and a bath with a view of the plains. It suits couples, photographers and those coming for the migration.
intros.nimali-serengeti: Nimali Serengeti is twelve tented suites in the heart of the Serengeti, two of them joined for families, each with a private veranda and a bath and outdoor shower, around a pool facing the plains. It suits first time safari goers, families and photographers.
intros.nomad-tanzania-lamai: Lamai Serengeti is built into a kopje in the far north of the Serengeti near the Mara River, with open fronted rooms, family rooms and a private camp, and a pool looking over the plains. Days bring game drives, migration river crossings in season, walks and sundowners.
intros.ol-jogi-conservancy: Ol Jogi is a private conservancy of 58,000 acres in Laikipia taken whole, with eleven bedrooms in stone cottages, a spa, gym, cinema and a tunnel hide at the waterhole. It breeds rhino and Grevy's zebra, with game drives, walks, horse riding and helicopter flights. Fly from Nairobi.
intros.ol-pejeta-bush-camp-asilia: Ol Pejeta Bush Camp is seven tents on the Ewaso Nyiro River in Ol Pejeta, home of the last northern white rhinos, each with a private deck over the river and a family tent. Days bring game drives, rhino tracking, walks and night drives. Fly to Nanyuki.
intros.rubondo-island-camp-asilia: Rubondo Island Camp is eight cottages on the shore of Lake Victoria on Rubondo Island, including a family cottage, each with a veranda looking over the lake, with a pool and a private beach. Days bring chimpanzee trekking, forest walks, boating and fishing. Fly to the Rubondo Island airstrip.
intros.saruni-eagle-view: Saruni Eagle View is nine raised tented suites above the plains of the Mara Naboisho Conservancy, each with a wide private veranda, with an observation terrace over a waterhole. Days bring game drives, walks and night drives with Maasai guides. Fly to the Ol Seki airstrip.
intros.saruni-wild-lodge: Saruni Wild is three tents in a remote corner of the Mara, one for families and two doubles, with hot bucket showers and a shared fire pit. Days bring game drives, walks, night drives and bush dinners with Maasai guides. Fly to the Mara North airstrip.
intros.sasaab: Sasaab is a lodge in Samburu above the Ewaso Nyiro River, with riverside and family suites, each with its own plunge pool, and a spa with a hammam. Days bring game drives, walks, camel safaris and visits with Samburu warriors, with a bush school for children. Fly to the Sasaab airstrip.
intros.segera-retreat: Segera is a retreat in Laikipia with garden and family villas, Segera House and the Farmhouse, with art across the grounds and a focus on conservation. Days bring game drives, walks, an art tour, the spa and helicopter flights. Fly to Nanyuki or the Segera airstrip.
intros.singita-explore: Singita Explore is a small private camp of six canvas tents set low among the trees on the open plains of the Grumeti Reserve, with bucket showers and meals shared over an open fire. It is the simplest way to see the Grumeti, on foot and by vehicle.
intros.singita-faru-faru-lodge: Singita Faru Faru is seven suites, a family suite and a two bedroom suite with its own pool in the Grumeti Reserve, each with floor to ceiling windows and decks looking over the river country. Days bring game drives, walks, migration viewing and the spa. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.singita-kilima: Singita Kilima is a villa on Sasakwa Hill in the Grumeti Reserve with five suites for up to ten guests, taken whole, with an infinity pool and heated pools in the main and junior suites, and its own chef and wine cellar. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.singita-mara-river: Singita Mara River is four tents and two family tents on the Mara River in the northern Serengeti, each with a bath looking over the river, with a pool and fire pit in camp. The migration crossings are close from June. Fly to the Lamai airstrip.
intros.singita-milele: Singita Milele is a five bedroom villa on a hilltop in the Grumeti Reserve taken whole, with its own pool, gym, spa, cinema, wine cellar, chef and butler, looking out over the Serengeti. Days bring private game drives with your own guide. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.singita-sabora: Singita Sabora is nine tented suites on the open plains of the Grumeti Reserve, each with its own pantry, a fitness area, a meditation deck and a sala looking over one of the camp's two waterholes. Days bring game drives, walks and migration viewing. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.singita-sasakwa: Singita Sasakwa is a manor house on a hill in the Grumeti Reserve with ten cottages of one to four bedrooms, each with a private plunge pool, and a two level Hillside Suite with its own pool. Days bring private game drives, walks, tennis and the spa. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.singita-serengeti-house: Singita Serengeti House is a private house in the Grumeti Reserve with four suites for up to eight guests, booked whole or by suite, with a 25 metre infinity pool, a tennis court and its own staff, chef and guide. Fly to the Sasakwa airstrip.
intros.sirikoi-lodge: Sirikoi is a lodge on Lewa among the fever trees, with tents, a cottage and Sirikoi House, and the option to take the whole place. Days bring game drives, rhino tracking, walks and helicopter flights. Fly to the Lewa airstrip or Nanyuki.
intros.suyian-lodge-by-and-beyond: Suyian Lodge is seven stone and thatch cottages above a valley cut by the Ewaso Narok River in Laikipia, each with an open air bathroom and a private veranda. It has its own waterhole and hide, food grown on site and walking safaris. Fly to Nanyuki.
intros.swale-camp: Swala Camp is twelve tented suites raised on wooden platforms beneath acacias in quiet southern Tarangire, beside a waterhole busy with elephants. Each has an outdoor rainfall shower, and the camp has a pool. Fly to the Kuro airstrip from Arusha.
intros.the-highlands-by-asilia-highlands: The Highlands is eight domed suites of perspex and canvas on the slopes of Olmoti in the Ngorongoro highlands, each with a wood burning stove and views of forest and volcanic mountains. Days bring crater game drives, hikes on Olmoti and Empakaai and Maasai visits. Fly to the Lake Manyara airstrip.
intros.ubuntu-migration-camp-asilia: Ubuntu is a mobile camp of ten tents that follows the Great Migration, in the northern Serengeti from June to mid November and the south from mid December to mid March. River crossings in the north and calving in the south are the draw, with walks in the north.
intros.wilderness-usawa: Usawa is a mobile camp of six canvas suites in the Serengeti for no more than twelve guests, moving through the year to follow the migration, the calving and the crossings. Fly to Kogatende, Seronera or Serengeti South depending on where the camp stands.
intros.beyond-sussuvlei-desert-lodge: Sossusvlei Desert Lodge is ten suites of stone and glass and a Star Dune Suite in a private desert reserve beside the NamibRand, each with a plunge pool, a fireplace and a skylight above the bed for the stars. The dunes of Sossusvlei are within reach. Fly to the lodge's own airstrip.
intros.benguerra-island-by-and-beyond: Benguerra Island is fifteen cabanas, casinhas and family villas on the white beaches of the Bazaruto Archipelago off Mozambique, each with a plunge pool and direct access to the beach. Days bring snorkelling and diving, horse riding on the beach, dhow cruises and island picnics. Fly into Vilanculos.
intros.blue-safari-seychelles: Alphonse Island Lodge is 22 beach bungalows on a coral island about 400 km south west of Mahé, an hour's flight away. There is a PADI dive centre, a fishing centre for the flats, a spa and food from the island's own farm.
intros.astove-coral-house: Astove Coral House is six rooms around a courtyard on Astove Atoll in the far Outer Islands of the Seychelles, above palm fringed beaches. It is a small, simple house for fly fishers and divers, with the flats and the Astove Wall close by.
intros.cosmoledo-eco-camp: Cosmoledo Eco Camp is eight Eco Pods on Wizard Island in Cosmoledo Atoll, near Aldabra in the far Outer Islands, each with a private deck and an outdoor shower. It suits fly fishers, divers and couples, with turtles, seabirds and wadeable flats around the lagoon.
intros.dulini-anabezi-lodge: Anabezi is twelve tented suites on the Zambezi in Zambia, including one family tent, each with a private plunge pool and a deck over the river, joined by raised boardwalks. Days bring game drives by day and night, walks, canoeing and boat trips. Fly into Lusaka for the transfer.
intros.expedition-blue-lagoon: Expedition Blue Lagoon is a seasonal boat, kayak and snorkel expedition to Cap Masoala for two to four guests, starting and ending at Masoala Forest Lodge, with Crusoe's Cabin as the base on the cape. Reef, rainforest and lemurs, far from other travellers. Fly into Maroantsetra.
intros.hoanib-elephant-camp: Hoanib Elephant Camp is ten tents on the Hoanib River in Kaokoland, eight twins and two family units, each with a private plunge pool and air conditioning. It suits families with children of any age, with desert elephants, rhino tracking and time with the Himba.
intros.hoanib-valley-camp: Hoanib Valley Camp is six tents in a hidden valley in Kaokoland above the Hoanib River, with furniture made by local carpenters and Himba carvers. Days bring desert adapted wildlife, rhino tracking and time with the Himba. Fly to the Orutjandja airstrip.
intros.kwessi-dunes-camp: Kwessi Dunes is twelve chalets in the NamibRand Nature Reserve, each with a separate open air star gazer room for sleeping under the desert sky, and a pool in camp. The dunes of Sossusvlei are within reach, with a private reserve to come home to. Drive or fly from Windhoek.
intros.masoala-forest-lodge: Masoala Forest Lodge is a set of treehouses where the largest lowland rainforest left in Madagascar comes down to a sheltered beach on the Tampolo Marine Reserve. Days move between forest walks for lemurs and the coral in the bay. Fly into Maroantsetra for the boat to the lodge.
intros.miavana-by-time-tide: Miavana is a private island off Madagascar's north east coast, reached only by helicopter, with thirteen ocean front villas of one to three bedrooms, each with a private pool. It sits in a 15,000 hectare marine protected area, with diving, lemur walks, whales from July to September and kiteboarding.
intros.nyamatusi-camp: Nyamatusi is six tented suites on the Zambezi in Mana Pools, each with a private plunge pool and a deck over the river. It is a camp for walking, with expert guides, canoeing past the floodplain and sundowners on the sandbanks. Fly to the Mana Main airstrip.
intros.royal-zambezi-lodge: Royal Zambezi Lodge sits on the Zambezi in Zambia with eight Deluxe Suites and seven Presidential Suites, each with a plunge pool, and a family suite. Days bring game drives, river cruises, canoeing, walks and tigerfish angling, with the Royal Bush Spa. Fly to the Royal airstrip from Lusaka.
intros.singita-katanza-house: Singita Kataza House is a private four bedroom villa for up to eight guests beside Kwitonda, sharing its border with Volcanoes National Park, with its own chef and host. Days are built around gorilla treks. Fly into Kigali for the drive to the house.
intros.singita-malilangwe-house: Singita Malilangwe House is a five bedroom house taken whole in the 115,000 acre Malilangwe Wildlife Reserve, with a rim flow pool above Malilangwe Dam and its own guide. Days bring private game drives, walks for guests aged sixteen and over, fishing and cruises on the dam. Fly into Buffalo Range.
intros.singita-pamushana: Singita Pamushana is eight suites above Malilangwe Dam, each with a private plunge pool, in a reserve home to a globally significant rhino population. Its stonework and thatch recall Great Zimbabwe. Days bring game drives, walks, cruises on the dam and visits to rock art. Fly into Buffalo Range.
intros.six-senses-zil-pasyon: Six Senses Zil Pasyon is a private island resort on Félicité, within a protected national park, with pool villas among granite boulders above coral fringed beaches. Days bring turtle hatching, a jungle hike past the Coco de Mer, island hopping and trips to Coco Island. Fly into Mahé.
intros.somalisa-acacia: Somalisa Acacia is four tented suites in the heart of Hwange, two of them for families, each with a wood burning fireplace and a private deck, beside a pan where elephants drink at the pool. It suits families, photographers and couples. Fly to the Manga airstrip from Victoria Falls.
intros.sushi-chuma: Sussi & Chuma is twelve thatched treehouse suites among ebony and jackalberry trees on a quiet bend of the Zambezi, seven miles upstream from Victoria Falls. Children aged six and over are welcome. Fly into Livingstone for the short transfer.
intros.the-hide-safari-camp: The Hide is a family run camp in Hwange facing a busy waterhole, with tents for couples, families and honeymooners, a private hide and an underground hide at the water's edge. Days bring game drives, walks and night drives. Fly into Victoria Falls or Hwange.
intros.time-tide-chinzombo-2: Chinzombo is six tents beneath old msikizi trees on the Luangwa River, one for families, each with a private pool and a soaking tub with river views. Days bring game drives, walks, boats from January to April and a night out under the stars. Fly into Mfuwe.
intros.time-tide-mchenja: Mchenja is five rooms in an ebony grove beside the Luangwa River, one for families, each with grass walls, large windows and an open air bathroom, with a pool above the river. Children of all ages are welcome. Open from late May to mid November. Fly into Mfuwe.
intros.time-tide-tsara-komba: Tsara Komba is eight ocean view rooms and suites on the forested slopes of Nosy Komba in the Nosy Be archipelago, each with a private outdoor lounge. It suits couples and families with children of any age, with lemurs, snorkelling and diving. Fly into Nosy Be.
intros.tongabezi: Tongabezi is hidden on the Zambezi twelve kilometres above Victoria Falls, with River Cottages, houses including the Honeymoon House and the Tree House, family houses and the private Tangala House. It suits honeymooners, families and anyone pairing the Falls with a safari. Fly into Livingstone.
intros.wilderness-bisate-lodge: Bisate is six forest villas at the foot of the Virunga volcanoes, built like giant nests, each with a fireplace and views to the volcanoes. Days bring gorilla trekking, golden monkeys, a hike up Mount Bisoke and tree planting on the reforested hillside. Fly into Kigali.
intros.wilderness-bisate-reserve: Bisate Reserve is four villas on the Bisate hillside, two of which link for families, each with a viewing deck to the volcanoes and a wood fired hot tub. Every stay supports reforestation around Volcanoes National Park, with gorilla and golden monkey treks. Fly into Kigali.
intros.wilderness-busanga: Busanga Bush Camp is four tented suites set on the ground on an island in the Busanga Plains in Zambia, with a raised pool and a fire pit. Days bring game drives, walks for up to six guests and night drives. Fly to the Busanga airstrip.
intros.wilderness-desert-rhino-camp: Desert Rhino Camp is six canvas and stone suites in the Palmwag Concession of Damaraland, one for families, each with its own stargazing deck. The draw is tracking black rhino on foot with rhino monitors. Fly to the camp's own airstrip.
intros.wilderness-damaraland: Doro Nawas is sixteen rooms of wood, canvas and thatch in Damaraland, each with an outdoor shower and a veranda for sleeping out under the stars, with a family suite and a pool. Days bring rock art at Twyfelfontein and drives for desert adapted wildlife. Fly to the Doro Nawas airstrip.
intros.wilderness-hoanib-skeleton-camp: Hoanib Skeleton Coast Camp is eight solar powered tented suites in the Hoanib Valley, where the desert runs to the Atlantic. Days bring desert adapted wildlife and the Skeleton Coast itself. Fly to the Hoanib airstrip.
intros.wilderness-kulala-desert-camp: Kulala Desert Lodge is 21 rooms of canvas and thatch at the gateway to the red dunes of Sossusvlei, two of them for families, each with a flat roof for sleeping out under the stars. Fly to the Kulala airstrip.
intros.wilderness-little-kulala: Little Kulala is eleven suites at the gateway to Sossusvlei, each with a private plunge pool, a rooftop for sundowners and suppers and a star bed on the deck, looking over the Namib. Fly to the Kulala airstrip.
intros.wilderness-magashi-peninsula: Magashi Peninsula is two suites with plunge pools and rooftop star beds and a private villa on Lake Rwanyakazinga in Akagera. Days bring game drives, night drives, boat trips on the lake and walks. Fly into Kigali.
intros.wilderness-ruckomechi: Ruckomechi is ten suites, including two family suites, in a forest of albida trees on the Zambezi on the edge of Mana Pools, all facing the river with the Rift Valley mountains across the water. Days bring game drives, canoeing, boat trips, tigerfish fishing and walks. Open from 1 April to 19 November.
intros.wilderness-sabyinyo: Sabyinyo is six stone cottages, two suites and a family unit at the foot of the Virungas, each with a fireplace and a veranda looking to the volcanoes. Days bring gorilla trekking, golden monkeys, volcano hikes and village walks. Fly into Kigali.
intros.wilderness-serra-cafema: Serra Cafema is eight suites, one for families, on the Kunene River in the far north west of Namibia, each with a deck over the water and interiors that honour Himba culture. It is a camp for solitude in a remote corner of the desert. Fly to the Serra Cafema airstrip.
intros.wilderness-shumba: Shumba is six tented suites on raised platforms over the Busanga Plains in Zambia, one for families, each with indoor and outdoor showers. The plains are known for lions, with game drives, walks and night drives. Fly to the Busanga airstrip.
intros.wilderness-toka-leya: Toka Leya is thirteen tented suites on the Zambezi, three for families, each raised on a deck with views over the river, close to Victoria Falls. Days bring white rhino walks with rangers in Mosi-oa-Tunya, river cruises and tours of the Falls. Fly into Livingstone.
intros.wolwedans-dune-camp: Wolwedans Dune Camp is where Wolwedans began, on a dune in the NamibRand, with six tented rooms and a family suite on raised platforms, each with a deck facing the desert. Days bring scenic drives, desert walks with a local guide, star bed nights and quiet. Fly to the Wolwedans airstrip.
intros.tswalu-reserve-loapi: Loapi is six tented homes at Tswalu in the southern Kalahari, each standing alone on the land with its own chef and butler, a deep deck, a plunge pool and a fire pit. It is off the grid and dark at night, with a private guide and vehicle for desert wildlife, San rock art and pangolin tracking. Fly by charter to the Tswalu airstrip.
intros.tswalu-reserve-tarkuni: Tarkuni is a homestead at Tswalu taken whole, with five en suite bedrooms for up to ten guests, its own chef, butler and guide, a plunge pool, a boma and a spa room. Days run to your own plan: tracking pangolin, aardvark and cheetah, horseback rides over the dunes and a night out at Malori. Fly by charter to the Tswalu airstrip.
intros.tengile-mala-mala-kirkmans-kamp: Kirkman's Kamp stands on a ridge above the Sand River on the site of the original 1920s camp, named for Harry Kirkman, a founder of the Sabi Sand. Its twelve cottages, one for families, each have a veranda facing the river, with a rim flow pool, a library and tea on the lawn. Game drives cross 10,500 ha known for leopard. Fly into Skukuza or the MalaMala airstrip.
intros.tengile-river-lodge-by-mala-mala: Tengile River Lodge is nine stilted suites on a bend of the Sand River in the Sabi Sand, each with a private rim flow pool, a sunken outdoor lounge and glass on every side. A fire pit, a reed boma and a wellness area sit in the guest area, with hippos and giraffe often in view. Fly into Skukuza or Kruger Mpumalanga International.
intros.tengile-mala-mala-rattrays-lodge: Rattray's Lodge is eight freestanding villas in a forest of giant riverine trees on the Sand River, named for Mike and Norma Rattray, who built MalaMala. Each villa looks over the floodplain with its own deck and plunge pool, and drives carry four guests or fewer across 13,500 ha. Fly into Skukuza or the MalaMala airstrip.
intros.tengile-mala-mala-camp: MalaMala Camp is one of the oldest safari camps in South Africa, on the Sand River in the MalaMala Game Reserve, with eleven thatched suites and eight large rooms facing the waterhole or the floodplain. A deck under a great jackalberry tree, a pool and gym over the river and the Buffalo Bar fill the day between drives. Fly into Skukuza or the MalaMala airstrip.
intros.tengile-mala-mala-sable-camp: Sable Camp is seven thatched suites on a rise above the Sand River in the MalaMala Game Reserve, for twenty guests at most, with a pool below the deck looking over the floodplain. The whole camp can be taken by one group of fourteen to twenty. Drives carry six guests at most, with walks and stargazing. Fly into Skukuza or the MalaMala airstrip.
intros.monwana-thornybush: Monwana is six suites and a private villa on 14,000 hectares of the Thornybush in the Greater Kruger, 45 minutes from Hoedspruit. Every suite has its own plunge pool on a terrace over the waterhole, the family suites come with their own safari vehicle, and Monwana Villa is a whole home for six with three pools, a chef and a fire deck. Fly into Hoedspruit for the drive to the lodge.
intros.shipwreck-lodge-namibia: Shipwreck Lodge is ten cabins shaped like stranded ships in the dunes of Skeleton Coast National Park, the only lodge in the park, each with a deck and a wood burning stove against the Atlantic fog. Days run to beach lunches by the sea, 4x4 drives to the clay castles of the Hoarusib River, sandboarding and the wrecks along the shore. Fly to the Mowe Bay airstrip via Windhoek.
intros.kwando-4-rivers: 4 Rivers is a classic camp of eight tented suites and one family suite on the banks of the permanent Tsum Tsum River, with the western side of the Kwara Private Concession in the northern Okavango Delta to itself. Walking is the speciality here, on Maboa Island and through the small delta in front of camp, with mokoro in season, game drives by day and night and a pool for the afternoons. Fly about 30 minutes from Maun to the airstrip, a 20 minute drive from camp.
intros.kwando-kwara: Kwara is nine suites in two small camps, Kwara South and Kwara North, on a forested island around a lagoon in the Kwara Private Concession, which shares a 30 km water boundary with Moremi Game Reserve. It is for adults only, with a three night minimum and four guests to a vehicle, and the water stays all year, so mokoro and boating run in every season beside game drives, night drives and visits to the Godikwe heronry. Fly about 30 minutes from Maun.
intros.kwando-lagoon: Lagoon is where Kwando began in the late 1990s: eight tented suites and one family suite on the shaded banks of the Kwando River, in a private concession of 232,000 hectares in the far north of Botswana. In the dry season elephants gather here in herds a thousand strong, and afternoons end on the double decker boat at sunset. Fly about 50 minutes from Maun or Kasane.
intros.kwando-lebala: Lebala is eight tented suites and one family suite in a southern corner of the Kwando concession, a reserve of 232,000 hectares it shares only with Lagoon. The draw is predators, wild dogs and cheetahs above all, tracked off road, with night drives, walks and a hide over the marsh and the Lebala Channel. Fly about 45 minutes from Maun or Kasane, and Lagoon is a free road transfer away.
intros.kwando-mma-dinare: Mma Dinare is nine suites and one family suite linked by walkways through riverine forest on the Gomoti River, in the Dinare Private Reserve on the border of Moremi Game Reserve, with more than 60 of its team from nearby Sankuyo village. Buffalo and elephants work the floodplain in front of camp with lions and wild dogs close by, and the days run to game drives, night drives, walks and mokoro. Fly about 20 minutes from Maun to the Santawani airstrip.
intros.kwando-moremi-crossing: Moremi Crossing is fourteen tented suites, a family suite and a honeymoon tent with an outdoor bath, on Ntswi Island on the Boro River opposite the southern tip of Chief's Island. Guides walk you onto Chief's Island, mokoro and boats leave from camp in the flood season, and a night of adventure camping under the stars can be booked ahead. Fly about 20 minutes from Maun to the Ntswi airstrip, ten minutes from camp.
intros.kwando-nxai-pan: Nxai Pan Camp is the only permanent camp in Nxai Pan National Park: eight suites and a family suite facing a waterhole where elephants come to drink, with a pool that looks over it. Between December and March the zebra migration arrives, and all year there are walks with the Bushmen, game drives and the journey out to Baines' Baobabs. Fly about 40 minutes from Maun.
intros.kwando-pom-pom: Pom Pom is eight tented suites and a family suite on Pom Pom Lagoon at the headwaters of the Xudum River, in a private concession west of Moremi Game Reserve. Mokoro and boats leave from camp during the floods from May to September, and game drives and night drives follow leopards, lions, wild dogs and a resident hyena clan. Fly about 20 minutes from Maun to an airstrip five minutes from camp.
intros.kwando-rra-dinare: Rra Dinare is eight suites and a family suite along the Gomoti River in the Dinare Private Reserve, just south of Moremi Game Reserve. Large buffalo herds bring the big cats, and the days run to game drives, night drives, walks and mokoro, ending with sundowners on the circular deck beside the fire. Fly about 20 minutes from Maun to the Santawani airstrip.
intros.kwando-splash: Splash is ten suites and two family rooms in the southeast of the Kwara Private Concession, with Splash Enclave, a private corner with its own plunge pool, lounge and dining, kept for groups of six to ten. Mokoro and game drives run all year after lion prides, cheetahs and wild dogs, with boating, fishing and the Godikwe heronry besides. Fly about 30 minutes from Maun to the Kwara airstrip.
intros.kwando-tau-pan: Tau Pan is the only safari camp in the Central Kalahari Game Reserve: eight thatched desert suites and a family suite on an ancient dune above a permanent waterhole. Bushmen lead walks on survival skills and medicinal plants, game drives look for black maned lions, and a deck is kept for sleeping out under the Milky Way. Fly about 55 minutes from Maun.
intros.xigera-safari-lodge: Xigera is twelve suites on stilts across two islands on the western edge of Moremi Game Reserve, each of 184 square metres and each its own gallery of African art and design, with a two bedroom Family Suite among them. A kilometre away stands the Baobab Treehouse, a steel baobab nearly ten metres tall where you can sleep in the open under the stars. The lodge runs on the sun and is free of single use plastic; fly via Maun, then by charter.
intros.leeu-estates: Leeu Estates is an estate of vineyards and gardens in the Franschhoek valley with rooms and suites in The Manor House and its old houses, and cottages from Terroir, two bedrooms around a private terrace, to Vineyard Cottage with a plunge pool over the vines. Breakfast, a Signature tasting of Mullineux & Leeu Family Wines and a shuttle into the village come with every stay, and Leeu Spa, the gym and the pool are on the estate. Cape Town International is the nearest airport.
intros.leeu-house: Leeu House is a small house of rooms in the middle of Franschhoek village, with marble bathrooms, some rooms with their own terraces, and a 15 metre pool looking to the mountains. Meals are taken in The Conservatory or out on the terrace, and the whole house can be taken for a private stay, the one way children under 18 are welcome. Cape Town International is the nearest airport.
intros.great-plains-duba-plains: Duba Plains is five suites on raised railway sleeper decks in the private Duba Concession, a mosaic of palm islands and floodplain in the heart of the Okavango Delta, where Dereck and Beverly Joubert have made their home for nearly twenty years. Lions swim the channels after lechwe and buffalo, and each suite has its own pool and a professional camera and lenses to use, with your images given to you when you leave. Fly to the Duba Plains Airstrip.
intros.mara-plains-camp-by-great-plains: Mara Plains is seven canvas suites on decks above the bends of the Ntiakitiak River, in the forest of the private Olare Motorogi Conservancy, with the Maasai Mara National Reserve to explore as well. Each suite has a deep copper bath, a veranda with a wood burning stove and a professional camera to use, and conservancy fees support over 1,000 Maasai families. Fly to the Ol Kiombo Airstrip.
intros.mara-toto-tree-camp-by-great-plains: Mara Toto is four suites in the tree canopy above the Ntiakitiak River in the Maasai Mara National Reserve, for no more than eight guests. It sits well for the southern migration and the green season, and each suite has a deep copper bath, its own lounge and a professional camera to use. Fly to the Mara North Airstrip.
intros.great-plains-selinda-main-camp: Selinda Camp is three suites, each with its own pool, on the banks of the Selinda Spillway where it enters the Linyanti River, designed by Dereck Joubert as a homage to elephants. The private Selinda Reserve is known for its large elephant herds, its wild dog pack and the Selinda lion pride of the film Birth of a Pride. Fly to the Selinda Airstrip.
intros.great-plains-zarafa-camp: Zarafa is four tented suites under ebony trees above the Zibadianja Lagoon, the source of the Savuti Channel, in the private Selinda Reserve, each with a copper bath, a plunge pool and a wide deck. Hippos keep to the lagoon and elephants walk through camp, and the reserve holds leopard, lion, cheetah, wild dogs, roan and sable. Fly to the Selinda Airstrip.
intros.great-plains-zarafa-dhow-suite: The Dhow Suite is a private two bedroom suite of 210 square metres at Zarafa, entered through a carved Lamu door, with its own butler, chef, guide and vehicle. A deck wraps around it with a plunge pool and a fire pit over the Zibadianja Lagoon, and each bedroom has a copper bath and showers inside and out. Fly to the Selinda Airstrip.
intros.anantara-ubud-bali: Anantara Ubud sits high in the Payangan rainforest north of Ubud, with Mount Agung on the skyline and 100 rooms, suites and pool villas, among them 15 pool residences. Days run from mountain hikes and temple visits to the spa, with kids' and teens' clubs and heated pools for families, and dinner is Indonesian at Kirana or Mediterranean from the wood fire at Amerta. Ngurah Rai International Airport is reached by road.
intros.kaaba-luum-mexico: Kaaba Luum is a private estate in the Mayan jungle near Tulum for up to 36 guests, with four villas named for the elements and a casita, each with its own plunge pool, and it can be taken whole. Meals are cooked by the estate's chefs under the palapa, the Ether Lounge holds yoga and sound baths, and the rooftop looks over the canopy at sunset. Cancún is about 90 minutes by car and Tulum about an hour.
intros.nomade-temple-madrid: Nômade Temple Madrid is 93 rooms and suites, two of them penthouses, in a restored building at Gran Vía 11 in the middle of Madrid. The design keeps the building's original character, the Deluxe and Premier rooms have their own balconies over the city, and there is a rooftop terrace with a plunge pool and the GÖN House of Healing spa. Madrid Barajas is about 25 minutes by car.
intros.singita-kwitonda: Singita Kwitonda is nine one-bedroom and two two-bedroom suites of volcanic stone on the edge of Volcanoes National Park, each with a fireplace and a heated plunge pool and the Virunga volcanoes in view. Treks set out from the park headquarters nearby for the mountain gorillas and golden monkeys, and at the lodge there is the Akarabo Nursery, a farm garden and a conservation lounge on Dian Fossey's work. Fly to Kigali, then 30 minutes by helicopter.
intros.singita-elela: Singita Elela, from the Setswana for to flow, is Singita's first lodge in Botswana: eight circular camps raised on stilts across concession NG26, about 170,000 hectares of the western Okavango Delta, each with its own pool, fire pit and lounge. It opens on 11 December 2026, with game drives, walks, mokoro and boats in season, and stargazing. Fly to Maun, then about 30 minutes by light aircraft to Elela's own airstrip.
